id.description: Unique identifier for the org's Space Classification

rank.description: Represents the rank of the classification. A number from 0 to 4, in which 0 usually refers to "public", and is the default whenever a rank cannot be determined.

title.description: Represents the classification title to be displayed in classified spaces for org users.

lastModified.description: The date and time the Space Classification was last changed.

orgId.description: A unique identifier for the Webex organization.
